package postgres

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

func TestPracticeCancelledPathItemStatus(t *testing.T) {
	items := []domain.LearningPathItem{{Position: 0, Status: domain.LearningPathItemInProgress}, {Position: 1, Status: domain.LearningPathItemPlanned}}
	status, ok := practiceCancelledPathItemStatus(domain.LearningPathStatusActive, items, 0)
	if !ok || status != domain.LearningPathItemReady {
		t.Fatalf("active no-ready: status=%s ok=%v", status, ok)
	}
	items[1].Status = domain.LearningPathItemReady
	status, ok = practiceCancelledPathItemStatus(domain.LearningPathStatusActive, items, 0)
	if !ok || status != domain.LearningPathItemPlanned {
		t.Fatalf("active competing ready: status=%s ok=%v", status, ok)
	}
	status, ok = practiceCancelledPathItemStatus(domain.LearningPathStatusPaused, items, 0)
	if !ok || status != domain.LearningPathItemPlanned {
		t.Fatalf("paused: status=%s ok=%v", status, ok)
	}
	if _, ok = practiceCancelledPathItemStatus(domain.LearningPathStatusCompleted, items, 0); ok {
		t.Fatal("completed path must conflict")
	}
}

func TestPathBoundReservedCancelDoesNotMutatePath(t *testing.T) {
	binding := domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding{LearningPathID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", LifecycleStatus: domain.PracticeLearningActionReserved}
	if shouldMutatePracticePath(binding, false) {
		t.Fatal("reserved cancel must not mutate the path")
	}
	if !shouldMutatePracticePath(binding, true) {
		t.Fatal("reserved open must mutate the path")
	}
	binding.LifecycleStatus = domain.PracticeLearningActionOpen
	if !shouldMutatePracticePath(binding, false) {
		t.Fatal("open cancel must restore the path item")
	}
}
